Goal: land the PO and enable billing before EOD Monday so we can pull this into the quarter. Proposed simple runbook below — please confirm owners where you see gaps:

- Novus action: confirm final legal/PO terms and send PO to finance@redwoodinference.com (target: 24 hours)
- Redwood action: lock in pricing and activate trial-to-paid path on receipt of PO (owner: David)
- CS action: confirm usage baseline and finalize start date (owner: Monica)

Immediate asks for Novus:
1) Confirm any open redlines in the SOW or PO process today.
2) Can you confirm who will sign the PO (name & title) so we can match procurement expectations?

Im looping in Priyom and Ben to help with any pricing/approval accelerations. Attaching the snapshot and a one-page leader summary — see attachments (Q4_commit_snapshot.csv).

Thanks,

1) Can you include the final SKU mapping and line-item pricing in the CSV? Our procurement needs a vendor SKU per line.
2) We have one outstanding redline in the data residency clause; legal is asking whether Redwood will accept an addendum limiting EU-hosted backups to our EU region (this does not affect the main SOW but they want it in writing).
3) PO timeline: finance would prefer to issue the PO tomorrow morning (Thu) if we can get the SKU lines and a PO-ready PDF.

- Ben: legal addendum draft + escalate if any pushback (tomorrow 10:00 PST)
- Monica: billing contact & activation checklist for finance packet (tomorrow 07:30 PST)

Ive also added the HubSpot deal link for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-9876. If we hit these targets we can reasonably close the PO by Thu morning and mark this commit as EOD Friday for internal forecasting.
